title: Grateful Dead Live at Folsom Field, University of Colorado on 1972-09-03
source: Candellario MSR > P > D > CD plus Audience tapes

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a rough early set that gives way to a crystal‑clear second set, highlighted by a smoking China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider and a monster Casey Jones.
ai_review.review: The tape switches to SBD at "Playing in the Band" and the first nine songs are described as terrible, but the second set is praised as “freakin' crystal” and “like a clear bronze bell.” Listeners love the energy of the late‑set jams – especially China Cat Sunflower/I Know You Rider and Casey Jones – while a few critics deem the source inferior to later composites.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (4‑5 stars) praise the show’s energy and second‑set sound, but a couple of 1‑star reviews criticize the source quality and early set, leading to an overall moderate‑high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First set rough/terrible; sound switches to SBD at "Playing in the Band" and stays decent through NFA. Second set described as crystal‑clear, like a bronze bell. Some claim the tape is inferior to later composite SBD+AUD releases.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
poor_songs: First nine songs of the first set (unspecified)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Rough, low‑fidelity opening half gives way to a brilliantly mixed second half; overall a long, high‑energy performance despite heat and occasional technical hiccups.
